title: Samsung Galaxy S26 and Galaxy S26 Ultra now available in India as part of Certified Re-Newed program
description: Samsung has announced that the Galaxy S26 and Galaxy S26 Ultra are now available in India through its Certified Re-Newed (CRN) program. Samsung claims that every CRN device is "inspected, cleaned, refurbished and tested through a Samsung-certified renewal process to meet Samsung’s standards for quality, performance and reliability." Each CRN device is reset to remove personal data and updated with the latest software before being sold to customers. It also packs a Samsung-certified battery, and where required, parts are replaced with genuine Samsung parts. The CRN Galaxy S26 and...

title: Xiaomi starts beta test recruitment for HyperOS 4
description: Xiaomi is now starting to recruit eager beta testers for its upcoming HyperOS 4 release for Global and EEA markets. If you want to give it a try, as always do keep in mind that beta software can have bugs and issues and is not recommended for your daily driver. If you want to go through with it even so, then you need to have a Xiaomi 17 Ultra, Leica Leitzphone by Xiaomi, or Xiaomi 17. Then, head on over to the Xiaomi Community app, tap Me, then Beta testing, and then Recruiting test. There will be a questionnaire for you to fill out. Xiaomi notes that for certain beta versions,...

title: Qualcomm outlines the improvements in the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro's new NPU
description: Qualcomm is introducing its Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 SoC as well as the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro at its annual Snapdragon Summit on September 22. Ahead of that event, today the company is teasing the improvements it's made to one of the chips' Hexagon NPU (presumably we're talking about the Hexagon NPU of the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro). This is built for agentic AI, with a transformer-focused Element Accelerator and a 50% larger shared memory that "keeps frequently accessed model data close to the NPU" so that agents "can stay responsive as they juggle longer context, more...

title: Here are the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max Geekbench scores
description: Yesterday, Apple unveiled the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, which are both powered by the new A20 Pro chip. As usual, the company has praised its latest and greatest SoC for being better than all of its predecessors, but how does it actually perform in a benchmark? Thankfully, we have a preliminary answer for that today, since two new iPhones identifying themselves as the iPhone 19,2 and iPhone 19,3 have just run Geekbench 6.7. Their single-core scores are 4,719 and 4,612, respectively, while their multi-core scores are 12,677 and 11,819, respectively. If we average the single-core...

title: Insta360 Luna Pro gimbal camera goes official with a 1-inch sensor
description: Insta360 is expanding its Luna series of gimbal cameras with the new Luna Pro. The handheld gimbal camera features a 1-inch sensor paired with a Leica Summicron lens, along with support for 8K Dolby Vision video recording and 10-bit I-Log. The Insta360 Luna Pro is powered by a 4nm chipset and also features a dedicated image processor, enabling its 1-inch sensor to capture video at up to 8K resolution and up to 1080p 240fps slow-motion footage. The gimbal camera features 3-axis stabilization, along with 2x lossless zoom and up to 4x HighRes zoom. The Luna Pro also features a...

title: Apple iPhone Duo vs. iPhone 18 Pro (Max): Which one to get?
description: Apple’s relatively stable smartphone line-up made it easy for people to figure out their upgrade path. The company would occasionally throw in a curveball like the iPhone Air or the iPhone 17e, but for the most part, people didn’t spend much time wondering which model to pick. Vanilla users got the new vanilla iPhone, Pro users got the new Pro. But now the iPhone Duo has arrived, Apple’s first foldable. Obviously, Android foldables have been around for a while now, so this isn’t a completely unprecedented experience. Still, for Apple die-hards this could be their first...

title: The Trump phone just got 50% more expensive
description: The Trump Mobile T1 Phone, announced with much fanfare (how else) last year, finally became available this June for $499. And if you wanted one, hopefully you were able to get it at that price. Now you can't. That's because the device has quietly received a sharp price increase up to a whopping $749. That's 50% more than it used to be, and considering the fact that this is just an HTC from 2024 with a gold paint job and Trump logo on it, well, let's just say you really need to be a huge Trump fan to justify the new price. There are many better-specced phones out there for the same...

title: Apple reveals the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max's battery capacities
description: Apple unveiled the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max yesterday, and today the company has done something that it really doesn't enjoy doing: publishing actual specs. Thanks to the EU, Apple has to make the phone's Energy Labels public, which it did today. You can see them below. This means we now know what the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max's battery capacities are in the EU. The former gets a 4,056 mAh cell, the latter a 5,391 mAh battery. Thus, the iPhone 18 Pro has a 1.45% larger battery than its predecessor, while the iPhone 18 Pro Max has an 11.8% bigger cell than the iPhone 17...

title: TrendForce: Apple to capture a quarter of the folding phone market in 2026
description: Following yesterday’s iPhone Duo announcement, TrendForce published a new report that outlines the state of the foldable phone market for 2027. According to the report, Apple will ship 5 million units of its folding phone by the end of the year. If this prediction turns out to be true, then Cupertino would be sitting at a 24.8% market share, which would slot it in second place, right behind Samsung. Global folding phone shipments are expected to reach 20.2 million units in 2026, which would make for a 0.5% rise compared to 2025. The upward trend with folding phones is then...

title: Here are the Apple iPhone Duo alternatives
description: Apple finally did it – it unveiled its first foldable phone and it is called the iPhone Duo. Arriving many years after the first foldables became available means that the Duo is entering a heavily contested market. Or is it? The Duo is the third kind of foldable. The first is the large book-style foldables pioneered by the Royole Flexpai and the Galaxy Fold. Shortly after arrived the second kind, the flip phone style, which was suitably introduced by the Motorola Razr. The Duo is a wide foldable, a relatively recent introduction. title: Motorola starts teasing its own wide foldable smartphone in response to the iPhone Duo
description: A few days ago some sketches leaked purportedly showing a wide foldable smartphone from Motorola, that was allegedly due to be released "in the coming months". Now, as a response to Apple's launch of the iPhone Duo, Motorola has officially started teasing the device on its X account. title: Samsung pulls the plug on the Galaxy Watch4 and Watch4 Classic - no more updates are coming
description: The Samsung Galaxy Watch4 and the Galaxy Watch4 Classic have reached the end of their update journeys. These two launched in August 2021 and were the first Galaxy watches to run Wear OS – previous models like the Watch3 used Tizen. They came with Wear OS 4 out of the box and were upgraded to version 6.0 – with One UI Watch 8 on top. That is their final Android version, but now they won’t even get security patches. Here is Samsung’s latest security bulletin – it details which devices are getting security updates and how often (i.e. monthly or quarterly). As you can see, the Watch4...

title: Google introduces ADB Wi-Fi 2.0 for faster and more reliable connections
description: If you are a mobile app developer, then you certainly know about ADB – the Android Debug Bridge. However, normal users have found uses for it too – some use it for things that the normal UI doesn’t allow (e.g. disabling certain apps, running scrcpy, etc.), others have used it for big data transfers (instead of doing it over MTP). Well, whatever your use case for ADB is, you’ll be glad to hear that Google just introduced Android Debug Bridge Wi-Fi 2.0. This new version reworks the three core components of the system to make it faster and more reliable. First is the ADB server....

title: Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra appears in leaked renders again, Tab S12+ tags along
description: Samsung said it would unveil the Galaxy Tab S12 series in H2 2026 but revealed nothing else. The series is rumored to include two tablets - the Galaxy Tab S12+ and the Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra. Leaked renders of the Tab S12 Ultra revealed its design, and now we are looking at the Tab S12+. The leaked renders of the Samsung Galaxy Tab S12+ show the tablet will come in gray and silver, feature a metal build, have a single rear camera, and support a stylus. You can also see that the tablet's right frame (in vertical orientation) has the volume rocker and power button. Samsung Galaxy Tab...

title: Apple iPhone Duo vs Galaxy Z Fold8 by the numbers
description: After years of rumors, leaks and anticipation, Apple finally unveiled its first folding phone. The iPhone Duo comes with a familiar short and wide form factor, which has been tried and tested by several Android makers, including Samsung with its own Galaxy Z Fold8. Apple versus Samsung is as big as it gets in the world of smartphones, and we've rounded up a quick specs comparison between the two foldables. title: Oppo Find X10 to feature dual 200MP cameras, Pro Max gets Open Gate
description: Oppo has revealed new camera details of the Find X10 and the top-end Find X10 Pro Max. Notably, the company recently confirmed that both phones will pack an 8,000mAh battery. The Oppo Find X10 will come with dual 200MP rear cameras, making it the first standard model in a flagship series to offer such a setup. Oppo has also revealed that the handset will feature a 0.99mm display bezel. The primary camera will use a 200MP sensor with an f/1.6 aperture, developed in collaboration with Hasselblad. It will also offer CIPA 6.0 professional-grade stabilization. The telephoto...

title: vivo X500's new design revealed ahead of launch
description: The vivo X500 series is set to launch in China on September 21. After recently teasing the X500 Pro Max’s design, the company has now revealed the updated design of the standard vivo X500, along with its available color options. Unlike its predecessor, the vivo X300, the upcoming vivo X500 will feature a redesigned rear panel. The phone gets a new camera layout with a large circular module positioned toward the left. The LED flash sits outside the circular module, while the entire camera setup is housed within a raised rectangular camera plateau that stretches across the width of...

title: Apple iPhone Duo, iPhone 18 Pro, Watch Series 12, Ultra 4 coverage wrap-up
description: Apple's 2026 iPhone event is now done, and it was an unusual one. We finally got to see Apple's inaugural folding iPhone, and it's intriguing, to say the least. It looks to be yet another product category that Apple was late to, but at which it arrived with its typical refinement and specialness. We'll see. We also got the new iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, both of which got a new main camera lens with a variable f/1.5 to f/4.0 aperture. The latest non-Pro AirPods are here. title: Apple raises prices of the iPhone 17 series, iPhone Air and iPhone 16
description: As expected, Apple has quietly raised the prices of several existing iPhone models shortly after announcing the iPhone 18 Pro lineup and its all-new foldable iPhone Duo. The price increase affects the iPhone 17, iPhone 17e, iPhone Air, and iPhone 16. The models mentioned above are now $100 more expensive than their respective launch prices, with the base iPhone 17 now starting at $899 in the US. The iPhone 17e now starts at $699, while the iPhone Air starts at $1,099. Meanwhile, the iPhone 16 is priced at $799 for the 128GB base model in the US. The price increase applies across...

title: Samsung starts selling Certified Re-Newed Galaxy S26, S26+, and S26 Ultra in the UK
description: Samsung's Certified Re-Newed program, which offers 'like new' refurbished devices through its official online store, has now added the Galaxy S26, Galaxy S26+, and Galaxy S26 Ultra in the UK. You can score a Certified Re-Newed S26 for £739 with 256GB of storage and £899 with 512GB, an S26+ with 256GB of storage for £929 and with 512GB for £1,079, and an S26 Ultra with 256GB of storage for £1,079, with 512GB for £1,239, and with 1TB for £1,469.
